C0512.title: Reverse Engineering API Encryption and Decryption Analysis
C0512.summary: During analysis of a foreign website, the core API was found to return encrypted strings. By setting browser breakpoints, the API request was intercepted and the decryption method was traced. Analysis of the JavaScript code confirmed the use of AES encryption.
